behaviors.behavior: Basis column forbids a bare 'assumed' cell in a greenfield spec
Basis column forbids a QUALIFIED 'assumed: <reason>' cell (fr_basis reports it 'malformed', not 'known') — the qualifier-smuggling loophole
the Basis ban is skipped for extension scope (greenfield-only per the ledger's own #4/#15 text)
only a NAMED Basis column is scored, never a positional/legacy cell
acceptance criteria carrying a code symbol / file path / ADR number are flagged, including against the REAL producer's bold-anchor + checkbox format (not just the heading-style fixture shape)
a declared split with zero active FR rows fails; one with rows-only-under-Removed also counts as empty
a declared split whose spec.md is missing entirely, or exists but cannot be read, fails loud rather than passing vacuously
a malformed / non-object / non-list project-config manifest fails loud instead of reading as 'zero splits declared'
split-name enumeration is manifest-driven (config 'splits' list), never directory-enumeration — a reserved non-split dir (campaigns/, grill-traces/, adr/) is never mistaken for a split
a non-string / absolute / traversal / Windows-drive-relative / Windows-root-relative split name is filtered as unsafe, never crashes the validator
starting guidance (CLAUDE.md + 3 agent_docs files) must exist AND be non-empty; skipped for extension scope; fails loud on a malformed/non-object config
